类 ProgressStreams

java.lang.Object
cn.msscn.progress.ProgressStreams
public final class ProgressStreams extends Object
Decorators and one-liners that turn byte sources into progress sources.

Accepted inputs: InputStream, OutputStream, File, Path, path strings and byte[]. The reporter receives cumulative bytes; for known sizes the total is set automatically. For unknown sizes use ProgressBar.Builder.unknownTotal().
